raw_definitions: Definisi : as sweet as ~, manis spt madu: her words are as sweet as ~, kata-katanya manis spt madu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n 1. sweet substance made by bees, /madu, manisan/ lebah; 2. ( colour ) kuning madu; 3. (US), ( term of endearment ) sayang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
